adjudication.depicted_input: Entity profile text / gene profile text being passed into a text-to-embedding step that yields the gene embedding used for the route.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible. It visibly shows the route-specific input object ('Text of gene x/y' derived from the LLM response) and the immediate transformation into a gene embedding via 'Text to embedding.' Under the atlas rules, the exact model name does not need to be printed inside the crop when the paper’s shared architecture/caption states that this text-encoding step is OpenAI TEXT-EMBEDDING-ADA-002 for this route. The crop is focused on the model-facing input portion rather than downstream evaluation or an unrelated model.
